goal: Prevent a qualified exact source revision from requiring a post-qualification source edit merely to enable training.
procedure: Keep optimizer/gradient/GPU authority false in source permanently. Introduce a separate runtime training-authorizer receipt that revalidates the exact CPU/GPU/token/corpus/teacher/mixture/static-proof evidence and opens only the optimizer authority needed by the trainer while keeping FINAL and private-identity gradient closed.
constraints: no source mutation after exact-head runtime receipts
decision_criteria: runtime receipt binds exact source revision and producer
source plan stays false for optimizer/gradient/GPU authority
authority: Transferable builder governance pattern; does not itself authorize Fable user-model training.
validation: Exact-head workflow 35954241662 passed with 257 tests and 217 static obligations.
failure_or_lesson: A builder can deadlock itself if empirical qualification is hash-bound to source but enabling the next phase requires editing that same source. Runtime authority should advance by receipts, not by mutating the qualified implementation.

goal: Ensure model selection and closure cannot silently switch checkpoint, evaluator, source revision, trainer implementation, or authority receipt.
procedure: Hash-bind checkpoint receipts to the exact trainer and training authorization. Bind DEV receipts to the exact evaluator, validation contract, gate registry, proof contract and training plan. Select the first passing checkpoint on a precommitted cadence from one complete linear checkpoint chain. Carry the selected checkpoint, DEV receipt, selector, training-authorizer, FINAL opening authorizer and frozen FINAL evaluator/package hashes through closure.
decision_criteria: every authority transition has exact receipt lineage
off-chain or duplicate DEV receipts fail closed
closure receipt contains complete authority chain
authority: General builder lesson for any generated model stack with staged fitting/evaluation.
validation: Exact-head workflow 35954241662 passed; no optimizer, gradient or FINAL authority was opened by the static suite.
failure_or_lesson: Passing metrics are not enough if the system cannot prove which code, checkpoint and evaluator produced them. Builder-generated models need end-to-end authority lineage, not only model-file hashes.

goal: Prevent runtime convenience values from becoming hidden model-capability ceilings or selection knobs.
procedure: Separate stage completion from invocation step budget. Permit exact-state same-stage continuation. Keep a precommitted nonzero learning-rate floor beyond the scheduler operating horizon. Freeze DEV checkpoint cadence before gradient. Treat microbatch, accumulation, GPU count, native window and stress sizes as measured operating points rather than semantic capability definitions.
decision_criteria: continuation remains trainable after nominal horizon
checkpoint selection surface is fixed before results
authority: Transferable builder design rule; measured operating points may guide execution but cannot define the user's eventual model capability.
validation: Static tests prove the distinction and exact-head CI remains green.
failure_or_lesson: A builder can accidentally cap a model without writing an explicit 'ceiling': zero learning rate after a nominal horizon, non-resumable step budgets, fixed save cadence chosen after results, or hardware assumptions can all create hidden ceilings.

goal: Prevent structural test presence or copied PASS payloads from masquerading as executed qualification.
procedure: Make the static proof auditor run the registered STATIC_REQUIRED pytest nodes itself on a clean exact source checkout, record JUnit collection/failure/error/skip counts, reject skipped required cases, bind the exact CI workflow and CI_REQUIRED receipt set, and hash-bind runtime receipts to their canonical producer implementations.
constraints: clean exact source before and after proof execution
required tests may not be skipped
decision_criteria: required nodes are actually collected and pass
authority: Builder validation lesson. Presence of validation code is not proof that the generated system was actually validated.
validation: Exact-head workflow 35954241662 passed with 257 tests, 217 static obligations and PASS_N0_FULL_PROOF_MATRIX_STATIC_AUDIT.
failure_or_lesson: A builder that only checks that tests or validators exist can certify an unexecuted system. Execution evidence, exact producer identity and fail-closed skip handling belong in the receipt chain.

goal: Stop provenance hardening from becoming its own objective while still closing the concrete P39PN runtime handoff required for a trustworthy N0 empirical run.
procedure: Re-read the successor objective and retrospective, classify future fixes by whether they prevent a false N0 pass, a hidden capability ceiling, topology/artifact mismatch, DEV/FINAL goalpost movement, or a direct full-envelope contradiction. Treat all other provenance-only additions as out of scope. Add one canonical P39PN materialization path that consumes exact CPU-qualified evidence, materializes every optimizer-facing public lane, freezes FINAL-v2 unopened, and emits the full public-mixture audit without optimizer or gradient authority.
constraints: no source edit merely to create more provenance
operating points are not capability ceilings
decision_criteria: static audit has no known unresolved STATIC_REQUIRED defect
new fix must change correctness of the eventual N0 capability claim rather than receipt aesthetics
authority: Transferable builder-governance lesson. Builder validation must be strong enough to protect claims but must stop once additional machinery no longer changes model correctness or phase authority.
validation: Exact-head workflow 35954996471 passed at f78cb119... with 259 tests, 219 STATIC_REQUIRED obligations, and 243 total proof obligations. Remaining blockers are non-static empirical gates.
failure_or_lesson: A builder can fail in two directions: under-validating a system, or over-engineering validation until it displaces the model-building objective. The stop rule is whether a new control prevents a real false-pass or capability error.

goal: Ensure FINAL independence and extrapolation are measured against every training lane that can teach the claimed capability, not only the base curriculum.
procedure: Before Magnolia, re-read the sealed FINAL audit against the actual optimizer-facing lanes. Add the semantic-operator long-context TRAIN/DEV lane to semantic relation/entity/surface/factor holdout checks. Compute full-fabric runtime-axis baselines over behavioral, runtime-view and long-context TRAIN/DEV together. Carry these inputs through the canonical P39PN materializer and CI proof obligation.
constraints: change only if omission can create a false generalization claim
decision_criteria: a heldout or extrapolation claim is valid only relative to all training surfaces that expose that capability
strengthened FINAL package must still materialize audit and freeze successfully before any gradient
authority: Transferable builder validation lesson; does not alter model architecture or authorize gradient.
validation: Exact-head workflow 35958513992 passed with 260 tests, 220 STATIC_REQUIRED obligations, 244 total obligations, successful strengthened FINAL package build/audit/freeze, and PASS_N0_FULL_PROOF_MATRIX_STATIC_AUDIT.
failure_or_lesson: A heldout benchmark can look independent while silently ignoring an auxiliary training lane. Builder-generated models must define the comparison set from every lane that owns the capability being claimed, not from the most obvious base dataset.

goal: Prevent a pre-gradient fixture defect from being misclassified as model evidence and prevent row-specific patching from becoming a retry ladder.
procedure: Classify the failure before mutation. Job 576060 had no optimizer/gradient and failed because a multi-step relation-schema fixture longified only one supervised candidate. Repair the whole supervision class: all supervised relation candidates, query evidence, factor evidence and step-conditioned factor evidence cross the intended window; spans are revalidated; static and real-token audits inspect the complete candidate set; TRAIN+DEV regression coverage locks the behavior.
constraints: no model conclusion from pre-gradient fixture failure
repair failure class rather than one row
decision_criteria: regression fails on old bug class and passes after class-wide repair
authority: Transferable builder lesson. Generated model pipelines must distinguish package/runtime evidence from learned-model evidence before deciding what to repair.
validation: Exact-head CI 35965145046 passed after the class-wide repair; subsequent current-lineage CPU qualification progressed through the repaired gate.
failure_or_lesson: A failed qualification is not automatically a failed model. Builders need explicit failure-substrate classification and should repair the governing class once, not accumulate local hotfixes.

goal: Reduce qualification/runtime cost without reducing the registered topology, training path, or eventual capability envelope.
procedure: Stop sending synthetic padded segment slots through the semantic backbone. Process only valid segments and scatter zeros back into invalid positions. Keep the same full system, losses, gradient connectivity and governed operating envelope. Add a regression proving only valid segments enter the backbone while the gradient path remains live.
constraints: efficiency is a constraint, not the objective
authority: Transferable builder optimization lesson. Efficiency should remove wasted execution, not shrink the user-model capability envelope.
validation: Magnolia job 576071 passed P40/P40A/P40B/P40C/P41/P42 with PASS_N0_FULL_ENVELOPE_CPU_RUNTIME_QUALIFICATION_V1, combined_parameters=243693339 and peak RSS about 2533.27 MiB.
failure_or_lesson: A builder can optimize a production-scale model without turning the optimization target into a permanent size or capability limit.

goal: Make builder-generated qualification/training workflows robust to real legacy HPC constraints without confusing orchestration failures with model behavior.
procedure: Treat the login shell as control plane and the qualified container as scientific runtime. Use legacy-compatible Git with explicit cd, one whole-stage container invocation, host-visible absolute paths, external Slurm logs, exact numeric job IDs, sacct after queue exit, immutable evidence roots, and CPU/GPU partition separation. Never delete failed evidence to permit a retry and never assume host/container HOME equivalence.
constraints: no host Python for scientific stages
no git -C or unproven modern Git on Magnolia
no untracked Slurm logs in exact-source checkout
no infrastructure failure promoted to model evidence
decision_criteria: exact clean source survives job execution
container sees the intended absolute inputs
job accounting is recoverable after SSH disconnect
authority: Transferable Fable Builder deployment lesson for generated training/evaluation plans on heterogeneous user compute.
validation: This operating model recovered the current N0 CPU and full-mixture execution path after multiple shell/environment mismatches.
failure_or_lesson: A scientifically correct builder can still fail if its orchestration assumes a modern host. Environment capability is part of the executable plan, but not part of model semantics.

goal: Repair the canonical distributed launcher after a real environment incompatibility without bypassing source authority or reusing receipts from a different source.
procedure: Diagnose job 576077 as a pre-qualifier rendezvous failure: torchrun --standalone advertised gpu001.cluster, which the udocker network could not resolve. Replace the canonical P43 launcher with the historically proven Accelerate multi-GPU path using a per-job main-process port, and add regression coverage rejecting standalone torchrun. Because source changed, invalidate and regenerate exact-source downstream receipts rather than reusing the prior CPU/P39PN lineage.
constraints: no shell-only bypass of canonical source defect
no reuse of runtime receipts across source revisions
no claim about P43 memory/model behavior before qualifier starts
decision_criteria: exact source and clean checkout bind every regenerated receipt
authority: General builder lesson: deployment-path defects that alter canonical execution code require requalification of all source-bound evidence.
validation: Exact-head CI 36043889153 passed at 0441f99d7d3f7df87b999fd7fc6074a7598be5d4. Current P39PN was subsequently regenerated on that source.
failure_or_lesson: Source-bound governance is useful only if it is obeyed when inconvenient. A one-line launcher change can invalidate otherwise good empirical receipts.

goal: Materialize the exact optimizer-facing public mixture and freeze FINAL on the current post-launcher-repair source before any gradient.
procedure: Consume current-source runtime/static receipts, exact governed FewRel, teacher-bank v0.5 and all public training lanes; materialize and audit the mixture; freeze FINAL-v2 without observing results or opening training; publish canonical receipt paths only after the complete manifest audit passes.
authority: Transferable builder materialization lesson. A generated model stack should construct one auditable optimizer-facing mixture rather than relying on implicit data discovery at training time.
validation: Job 576079 completed 0:0. PASS_N0_FULL_PUBLIC_MIXTURE_MANIFEST_AUDIT_V1 at source 0441f99d7d3f7df87b999fd7fc6074a7598be5d4; 8 lanes, 10 macro families, natural relation 39200 TRAIN/5600 DEV, teacher bank 1020 rows/51 competencies; optimizer=false, gradient=false, final_results_observed=false.
failure_or_lesson: The mixture is part of model authority. Builder-generated training must bind the exact lanes and frozen evaluation surface before gradient.

goal: Keep the builder aligned with newly canonical personal-development and memory-use architecture without incorrectly folding those responsibilities into the public N0 foundation.
procedure: Preserve user/host, assistant-self, relationship and source-person subject separation. Require the eventual experience→state→native judgment→outcome→revision causal loop. Treat memory influence as invocation-scoped IGNORE/BOUND/CONTROL under existing authority. Localize failures across memory/retrieval/context-harness/model/tool/environment/evaluator substrates before mutation. Keep usage-aware retrieval and lightweight memory-control as derived challengers and parametric memory as a future rebuildable substrate, not truth/identity authority.
constraints: downstream LLM behavior is not proof of learned personal judgment
retrieval rank/repeated use cannot elevate Claim or identity authority
source-person identity and assistant-self continuity remain distinct
no permanent algorithm or latent-size ceiling
decision_criteria: personal state causally changes native judgment when relevant
builder chooses the implicated substrate rather than defaulting to model retraining
authority: Canonical main architecture transfer. This informs later builder/memory/identity stages and does not authorize changing the current N0 source or training on private identity data.
validation: Main currently contains these canonical documents at head 5f9b9ccb2628eb2a5512d8624b9a78bcc9c7fe38.
failure_or_lesson: Fable Builder is not merely a personality-model trainer. It must form and connect multiple user-specific model/state substrates while keeping authority and subject boundaries explicit.

observation: The two-rank P43 run reached the real DDP joint step but failed because the registered system splatted a TeacherMultitaskCollator batch into the native semantic model. Objective-only metadata (group_sizes, preferred_masks, principle_tags, ids) crossed an interface that accepts only candidate/rationale tensors and candidate_rationale_index.
transfer: A builder must distinguish model-native inputs from orchestration/objective metadata at every generated adapter boundary. A structurally valid component graph is insufficient if generated wrappers widen interfaces implicitly.
qualification_rule: Before expensive hardware qualification, execute every real generated/registered lane through its production adapter with strict downstream signatures and representative metadata present. Permissive fakes do not prove adapter compatibility.
anti_hotfix_rule: Repair the adapter/interface class and move the reproducer into a cheaper earlier gate. Do not teach downstream models to accept accidental metadata merely to make one run pass.
authority: No claim that the repaired N0 runtime has passed requalification yet.

observation: P42 was strengthened to execute the real registered MLM and governed-judgment replay adapters on CPU/no-grad before P43, including objective metadata that must remain outside the native semantic model.
transfer: Fable Builder should generate qualification ladders that place deterministic interface/schema failures at the cheapest faithful substrate capable of reproducing them, while reserving GPU gates for properties that genuinely require GPU/distributed execution.
authority: Cheap-gate coverage complements rather than substitutes for the later exact topology/runtime qualification.

lesson: A pretraining builder must treat mixed-precision dtype boundaries as runtime interface contracts. Structural masking constants must be representable in the tensor being masked; deriving a finite floor from an upstream operand can pass fp32 CPU qualification yet fail when autocast lowers the result tensor.
observed_path: semantic operator streaming late interaction under fp16 autocast
governance: Preserve failed GPU evidence; classify the numeric boundary; audit sibling streaming kernels; add a cheaper exact reproduction before another GPU attempt.

lesson: When a GPU-only-looking defect is reproducible with CPU autocast, move that failure class into the pre-GPU proof chain. Keep the real GPU stage for topology/DDP/memory evidence rather than spending scarce accelerators on deterministic dtype-contract failures.
governance: Executable CPU fp16-autocast regression plus proof-matrix source constraints across all registered streaming mask-floor kernels.
